name: onv-mcp
description: ONV MCP server 与官方 SDK 的公开镜像仓

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/sdk-ts && npm run build -w packages/mcp-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/sdk-ts && npm run typecheck -w packages/sdk-ts && npm run typecheck -w packages/mcp-server
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/sdk-ts && npm run test -w packages/mcp-server
